results.title: BEI Suspends Trading of PT Charnic Capital Tbk, PT Asri Karya Lestari Tbk, PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk and PT Guna Timur Raya Tbk
results.body: On 4 September 2026, BEI temporarily halted trading of PT Charnic Capital Tbk, PT Asri Karya Lestari Tbk, PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk and PT Guna Timur Raya Tbk after their share prices surged by hundreds of percent, prompting a cooling‑down measure to protect investors. The suspension, effective from session I in both the Regular and Cash Markets, will remain in force until further notice, as stated by Endra Febri Styawan, Acting Head of Transaction Supervision Division at BEI.

results.title: Bursa Efek Indonesia suspends trading of PT Guna Timur Raya Tbk, PT Charnic Capital Tbk, PT Asri Karya Lestari Tbk and PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk
results.body: Bursa Efek Indonesia suspended trading of four listed companies at the start of the first trading session on Friday, 4 September 2026. The suspended stocks are PT Guna Timur Raya Tbk, PT Charnic Capital Tbk, PT Asri Karya Lestari Tbk and PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk. In the past month, PT Charnic Capital Tbk rose 100%, PT Asri Karya Lestari Tbk rose 91.8% but fell 27.6% year‑to‑date, PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk surged 119.4% and up 66.3% year‑to‑date, and PT Guna Timur Raya Tbk jumped 99% and up 100.9% year‑to‑date, prompting the exchange to act. The exchange said the suspensions aim to cool down abnormal price movements and protect investors by giving them time to consider decisions based on available information.

results.title: BEI lifts suspensions on four stocks: PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk, PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk, PT Alakasa Industrindo Tbk, PT Asia Sejahtera Mina Tbk
results.body: On Thursday, 3 September 2026, the Indonesia Stock Exchange lifted the temporary suspensions on the shares of four listed issuers. The affected issuers are PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk, PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk, PT Alakasa Industrindo Tbk, and PT Asia Sejahtera Mina Tbk, whose shares had been halted due to sharp price spikes. Prior to the lift, PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk’s shares rose 84.7% in the past month and 110.8% year‑to‑date, PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk’s shares rose 99.1% month‑over‑month and 50.9% YTD, PT Alakasa Industrindo Tbk’s shares surged 167% in the month and 1,151% YTD, and PT Asia Sejahtera Mina Tbk’s shares climbed 187.3% in the month and 666.9% YTD. BEI said the suspensions, imposed on 2 September for PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk and PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk, on 24 August for PT Alakasa Industrindo Tbk, and on 19 August for PT Asia Sejahtera Mina Tbk, were a cooling‑down measure to protect investors, and the lifting now permits trading in both the regular and cash markets.

results.title: BEI Lifts Suspension on PPGL, ALKA, LIFE, and AGAR Shares, Trading Resumes Thursday (Sept 3)
results.body: Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) announced on Wednesday (Sept 2, 2026) that it will lift the trading suspension on four stocks effective Thursday (Sept 3, 2026). The affected companies are PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk (PPGL), PT Alakasa Industrindo Tbk (ALKA), PT Asia Sejahtera Mina Tbk (AGAR), and PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk (LIFE). PPGL had been suspended since Sept 2 after rising 43.7% in five days to Rp 388 per share and 94% over one month. ALKA was suspended on Aug 24 after surging 429.48% in a month to Rp 4,580, and will resume in the Session I Periodic Call Auction. AGAR faced two suspension periods: first from Aug 19 after a 258.41% monthly gain to Rp 1,810, and again from Sept 2 after a 99.14% monthly rise to Rp 11,550.

results.title: Bursa Efek Indonesia suspends trading of PT Steady Safe Tbk, PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk and PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk
results.body: Bursa Efek Indonesia temporarily suspended trading of PT Steady Safe Tbk, PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk and PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk on the regular and cash markets, effective from the first session on 2 September 2026, due to a significant cumulative price increase. The suspension, described as a cooling‑down measure, aims to give investors time to consider decisions based on available information until further notice.

results.title: BEI suspends PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk, PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk and PT Steady Safe Tbk after Auto Reject Top (ARA) hit Rp875
results.body: The Indonesia Stock Exchange (BEI) temporarily halted trading of PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk, PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk and PT Steady Safe Tbk starting in session I on Tuesday, 2 September 2026. The suspension was announced by Endra Febri Styawan, Acting Head of the BEI Transaction Supervision Division, as a cooling‑down measure following a significant cumulative price increase that triggered an Auto Reject Top (ARA) at 25 % to Rp 875. SAFE faces a second suspension that could keep its shares locked for more than a day and possibly up to a week, while LIFE and PPGL are likely to be suspended for a single trading day each. PPGL had risen for six consecutive days since 24 August, highlighting the rapid price movement that prompted the exchange’s action.

results.title: PT Bursa Efek Indonesia Suspends PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk, PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk, and PT Steady Safe Tbk Over Sharp Price Gains
results.body: PT Bursa Efek Indonesia temporarily suspended trading of three stocks—PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk, PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk and PT Steady Safe Tbk—starting in the first session on Wednesday, 2 September 2026. The suspension was imposed because the shares experienced unusually rapid price increases, with PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk rising 84.7% over the past month and 110.8% year‑to‑date, PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk gaining 99.1% over the month and 50.9% year‑to‑date, and PT Steady Safe Tbk climbing 136.4% over the month and 118.7% year‑to‑date. Yulianto Aji Sadono, head of the Transaction Monitoring Division, said the measure provides a cooling‑down period to protect investors by allowing them time to consider decisions based on available information. The exchange urged interested parties to monitor disclosures from the listed companies.

results.title: Top Gainers on the IDX on 31 August 2026 led by PT DMS Propertindo Tbk soaring 34.16% after announcing a rights issue
results.body: PT DMS Propertindo Tbk jumped 34.16% to 216 on 31 August 2026 after disclosing a rights issue of 100 billion new shares at Rp25 each, aiming to raise Rp4.4 trillion for land‑asset acquisitions. Other notable gainers included PT Indo Acidatama Tbk up 31.8% to Rp97, PT Asri Karya Lestari Tbk up 25% to Rp310, Bank Sinarmas Tbk up 24.82% to Rp880, PT Fortune Indonesia Tbk up 24.62% to Rp2,480, PT Kedaung Indah Can Tbk up 24.37% to Rp296, PT Logindo Samudramakmur Tbk up 18% to Rp118, PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk up 17.46% to Rp9,925, PT Olympus Strategic Indonesia Tbk up 16.79% to Rp800, and PT Indo Oil Perkasa Tbk up 15.93% to Rp262. The IDX Composite closed up 0.11% at 6,525.47, with 413 advancing, 245 declining and 305 unchanged stocks and a total market capitalization of Rp11,448.27 trillion. PT DMS Propertindo Tbk is identified in the article as the issuer (emiten) of the rights issue, while the other companies are listed solely as stocks that recorded price gains.

results.title: MSIG Life’s claims total Rp545 billion, with a majority of death claims involving young adults
results.body: PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk reported total health and death claims of Rp545 billion for the first half of 2026, of which Rp433.4 billion were health claims and Rp111.8 billion were death claims. Among individual policyholders, 55% of death claims occurred in the productive‑age group (25‑59 years), with the age breakdown of 2% under 25, 13% aged 25‑44, 42% aged 45‑59 and 43% aged 60 and above. The insurer highlighted a Risk Based Capital ratio of 1.382%, well above the OJK minimum of 120%, and disclosed net premium income of Rp1.78 trillion, investment income of Rp80.47 billion, bringing total income to Rp2.02 trillion. Industry data from OJK showed life‑insurance premiums grew 8.40% year‑on‑year to Rp94.83 trillion.

results.title: MSIG Life reports 68.61% rise in net profit to Rp 180.6 billion in H1 2026
results.body: MSIG Life announced its first‑half 2026 results, showing net profit of Rp 180.60 billion. This profit represents a 68.61% increase from Rp 107.11 billion in the same period last year. The company also reported insurance service revenue of Rp 1.02 trillion, insurance service result of Rp 22.11 billion, total assets of Rp 15.11 trillion and equity of Rp 8.19 trillion. Director Eiji Takahashi attributed the gain to stronger core insurance business and a diversified investment portfolio that limited the impact of volatile domestic equity markets.
